parameters: Merchant's Guild - MEMBERS ONLY
(Something tells you they don't want kids here either.)
Citizen: Those shopkeepers in Zeck look you up and down,
then decide if you're "ready" for their wares or not, but
here in Fesh you can find stores where they don't care, if
you can find them.  But their selections aren't as large.
Citizen: Don't you hate those types that dress up in clown
outfits and throw knives at you?  They are there for
tourists, but to kill and rob them, not entertain.  They
also have nasty confusion-inducing abilities of some sort.
Citizen: The Inn is much larger here than in Zeck.  Some
people who vacation on this island stay at the Inn here and
have fun in both towns.
Citizen: The armor shop here is nothing like the one in
Zeck.  The shop in Zeck is huge, just gigantic.  So is the
weapon shop there.
Citizen: That is a BIG diner, much bigger than the ones
at Zeck, and the pubs.  They must be big competition for
the pubs, as a lot of people frequent both.  You should see
all the food inside behind the counter when you walk in!
Citizen: You know what they say about the pubs, how they're
all part of a chain and their company keeps them looking
mostly the same inside, but visiting one doesn't mean you've
visited them all, with how they differ!  Its true!
Citizen: Ah!  The merchant's guild, right at the docks.  Its
for corporations and businesses that ship cargo in and out
of the port, for example shipments of stuff to sell in the
stores.
Not a tourist attraction or place to have any fun, the
merchant's guild pretty much a bunch of offices and areas
where businessmen and ship captains meet up and do paperwork
and administrative stuff when their ships come and depart.
Just a bunch of offices and a storage area for shipments,
cargo, and cargo to be inspected and so forth.  Pretty
boring actually.  Not a surprise it isn't open to the
public.
Those who are not the crew of a commercial cargo vessel,
and instead are on vacation or to see fireworks or a parade,
probably want either the ticket office just to the left of
the merchant's guild, or the Inn or the pub, or the stores.
Citizen: Found it!  I was wondering where the back area of
town was, with the shops to explore!
Kid: The shops in this town kinda suck.  The ones in Zeck
have a lot more stuff.  I remember one of the huge shops
there has it's own cafeteria and food you can buy in it!
Citizen: Monsters and bandits got really bad on this island
but its a lot better after they made the town walls bigger.
